start.description: start date for the data point

outlierCode.description:
outlierCode: 0 or no value -- regular point
             1 -- to be ignored when returning results of value outlier analysis
             2 -- is an estimated value
             3 -- combination of 1 and 2 together

enum (0, 1, 2)

comments.description: (Optional) any comments for the data point

isEstimated.description: Denotes if the value is an actual value or an estimated value. default = null (actual value)

dataVersion.description:
Same data points can have different data version to denote priority. Default behavior in case of overlapping
data points is to pick the data point with the highest data version.
If data version is not specified, then default (avg) overlap handling is applied to the overalapping data points

statusCode.description: Customer specific status code for the data point (may be used to denote data quality)

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

contribution.description:
The numerical value for the contribution of the feature or factor to the overall risk score prediction.
This value represents the impact that the given feature has on the final prediction, based on the model's
learned parameters. The contribution can be positive (indicating an increase in the risk score) or negative
(indicating a decrease in the risk score).

contributionLowerBound.description:
The numerical value of the lower bound for the contribution of the feature to the risk score prediction.
This represents the lower end of the confidence interval or the uncertainty in the contribution's value.
It provides insight into the potential variability of the contribution and helps quantify the confidence
in the model's prediction for this feature.

contributionUpperBound.description:
The numerical value of the upper bound for the contribution of the feature to the risk score prediction.
This represents the upper end of the confidence interval or the uncertainty in the contribution's value.
It provides insight into the potential variability of the contribution and helps quantify the confidence
in the model's prediction for this feature.

title:
This type represents the validation contributions related to a risk score prediction in a machine learning model.
The validation contribution provides an assessment of how much each factor (or feature) contributes to the
overall prediction, and it is used to assess the model’s accuracy and reliability.

The entity is designed to capture and store the contribution of specific features or factors in the model's
prediction, including their associated uncertainty ranges (lower and upper bounds).
This type can be used in the context of model validation, where you want to understand the impact of each feature
on the predicted risk score, providing a more transparent and interpretable machine learning model.
name: ReliabilityRiskScoreMlValidationContribution
